chinese: 記敘視角
『我把雨傘借給新同學，自己跑回課室。』誰是敘述者？
The narrator says, ‘I lent my umbrella to a new classmate and ran back to class.’ Who narrates?
借出雨傘的人|新同學|全知旁觀者
The umbrella lender|The new classmate|An all-knowing observer
『我』直接敘述自己的行動，是第一人稱。
‘I’ narrates their own action: first-person narration.
比喻
『她的鼓勵是一盞燈，照亮我迷惘的路。』主要修辭是甚麼？
‘Her encouragement was a lamp lighting my uncertain path.’ What is the main device?
暗喻|反問|排比
Metaphor|Rhetorical question|Parallelism
把鼓勵直接比作燈，突出引導作用。
Encouragement is presented as a lamp to emphasise guidance.
因果推論
文章說『安裝 AI 後，借書量增加，因此一定是 AI 的功勞』。哪項批評最合理？
A text says borrowing rose after AI was installed, so AI must be the cause. What criticism is justified?
未排除同期閱讀活動的影響|時間先後已能證明因果|借書量不能量度
A simultaneous reading campaign was not ruled out|Sequence alone proves causation|Borrowing cannot be measured
同時發生的其他因素也可能影響結果。
Other changes occurring at the same time may affect the result.
論據關聯
論點是『圖書館應延長開放時間』。哪項資料最直接支持？
Which evidence most directly supports longer library opening hours?
訪問顯示很多學生放學後仍需使用館內資源|書架是綠色|校門有兩個入口
Many surveyed students need library resources after school|The shelves are green|The school has two gates
論據須直接回應使用時間與實際需要。
Evidence should address hours of use and actual need.
語氣與立場
『這項方案或能改善效率，惟成效仍待驗證。』作者態度最接近甚麼？
‘This plan may improve efficiency, but its effects remain to be tested.’ What is the stance?
審慎支持|完全否定|毫無保留支持
Cautious support|Complete rejection|Unqualified support
『或能』及『仍待驗證』保留了不確定性。
‘May’ and ‘remain to be tested’ explicitly retain uncertainty.
綜合論證
兩篇文章分別主張 AI 批改節省時間和可能忽略方言。綜合兩者，哪個結論較完整？
One article says AI marking saves time; another says it may overlook dialect. Which synthesis is strongest?
試行 AI 輔助並保留教師覆核與申訴|效率高便不需覆核|只要有風險就拒絕所有工具
Pilot AI assistance with teacher review and appeal|Efficiency removes the need for review|Any risk means rejecting every tool
結論同時處理效率、限制與可行保障。
The synthesis addresses benefits, limitations and practical safeguards.
english: Subject–verb agreement
Choose the correct sentence.
Choose the correct sentence.
She checks the source.|She check the source.|She checking the source.
She checks the source.|She check the source.|She checking the source.
一般現在式中，第三人稱單數動詞加 -s。
In the present simple, a third-person singular subject takes checks.
Past tense
Choose the verb: Yesterday, we ___ the AI answer.
Choose the verb: Yesterday, we ___ the AI answer.
checked|check|checking
checked|check|checking
Yesterday 指已完成的過去時間，所以用 checked。
Yesterday refers to a completed past time, so use checked.
Passive voice
Choose a correct passive version of ‘The teacher reviewed the report.’
Choose a correct passive version of ‘The teacher reviewed the report.’
The report was reviewed by the teacher.|The report reviewed the teacher.|The report is review by the teacher.
The report was reviewed by the teacher.|The report reviewed the teacher.|The report is review by the teacher.
過去式被動語態是 was/were 加過去分詞。
The past passive uses was/were plus the past participle.
Conditional reasoning
Choose the sentence describing an unreal present situation.
Choose the sentence describing an unreal present situation.
If I had more evidence, I would revise my claim.|If I will have evidence, I revise yesterday.|If I had evidence, I will revised it.
If I had more evidence, I would revise my claim.|If I will have evidence, I revise yesterday.|If I had evidence, I will revised it.
第二類條件句常用 if 加過去式，以及 would 加原形動詞。
A second conditional commonly uses if plus past tense, then would plus a base verb.
Cautious claims
Which statement best reflects a small study of 12 students?
Which statement best reflects a small study of 12 students?
The findings suggest a possible benefit in this group.|This proves the tool works for every learner.|All schools will obtain identical results.
The findings suggest a possible benefit in this group.|This proves the tool works for every learner.|All schools will obtain identical results.
小樣本支持有限的推論，不足以推廣至所有學生。
A small sample supports a limited inference, not a claim about every learner.
Evaluating an argument
A report says an AI tutor is ‘reliable’ but provides no test data. Which response is strongest?
A report says an AI tutor is ‘reliable’ but provides no test data. Which response is strongest?
Request the evaluation method, sample and error rates.|Accept the claim because the language sounds professional.|Reject it solely because it was written online.
Request the evaluation method, sample and error rates.|Accept the claim because the language sounds professional.|Reject it solely because it was written online.
評估論證要檢查方法及證據，而非文風或媒介。
Evaluate the method and evidence, not merely style or publication medium.
maths: 兩邊減 5，再除以 3，得到 x = 5。
Subtract 5 from both sides, then divide by 3: x = 5.
原價 $200 的物品先加價 10%，再減價 10%。最後價格是多少？
A $200 item rises by 10%, then falls by 10%. What is its final price?
What are the solutions of x² − 5x + 6 = 0?
連續擲兩次公平硬幣，兩次都是正面的概率是多少？
A fair coin is tossed twice independently. What is the probability of two heads?
40 人中有 20 人參加音樂組，其中 8 人也參加美術組。已知一人參加音樂組，他也參加美術組的比例是多少？
Of 40 students, 20 join music; 8 of those also join art. Among music members, what proportion also join art?
已知是音樂組成員，分母應為該組的 20 人。
Conditioning on music membership makes the denominator 20.
chemistry: 混合物分離
要從沙與水的混合物中取出不溶沙粒，最合適的方法是甚麼？
How should insoluble sand be separated from a sand–water mixture?
過濾|加更多水|只攪拌
Filtration|Adding more water|Stirring alone
濾紙截留不溶沙粒，水可以通過。
Filter paper retains insoluble sand while water passes through.
控制變量
比較水溫對溶解快慢的影響，哪項應保持相同？
When comparing the effect of water temperature on dissolving speed, what should stay the same?
糖的質量及顆粒大小|每杯水溫都不同且糖量隨意|同時改變所有條件
Sugar mass and particle size|Use arbitrary sugar amounts|Change every condition together
只改變水溫，其他相關條件保持一致，才可比較。
Vary temperature while keeping other relevant conditions consistent.
原子結構
中性原子有 11 個質子，應有多少個電子？
A neutral atom has 11 protons. How many electrons does it have?
中性原子的質子數與電子數相同。
A neutral atom has equal numbers of protons and electrons.
物質的量
某物質摩爾質量為 18 g mol⁻¹。36 g 含多少 mol？
A substance has molar mass 18 g mol⁻¹. How many moles are in 36 g?
2 mol|18 mol|648 mol
2 mol|18 mol|648 mol
物質的量 = 質量 ÷ 摩爾質量，即 36 ÷ 18 = 2 mol。
Amount = mass ÷ molar mass = 36 ÷ 18 = 2 mol.
酸鹼數據
本題量度得到溶液 A 的 pH = 3，B 的 pH = 6。哪個 pH 較低？
Measured pH values are A = 3 and B = 6. Which has the lower pH?
A|B|兩者相同
A|B|They are equal
比較數據，3 小於 6；不可把 pH 數值較大誤當酸性較強。
3 is less than 6; a larger pH does not mean greater acidity.
反應速率
兩個相同反應量度前 10 秒產氣：A 為 20 cm³，B 為 35 cm³。哪個平均產氣速率較大？
In the first 10 seconds, reaction A produces 20 cm³ of gas and B 35 cm³. Which has the higher average rate?
B：3.5 cm³/s|A：20 cm³/s|兩者相同
B: 3.5 cm³/s|A: 20 cm³/s|They are equal
平均速率為體積除以時間；B = 35/10，A = 20/10。
Average rate is volume divided by time: B = 35/10, A = 20/10.
geography: 地圖方向
地圖上方是北方，學校在公園右邊。學校在公園哪一方？
North is at the top of a map. A school lies to the right of a park. In which direction is the school?
東方|西方|南方
East|West|South
北向上的地圖，右方是東方。
On a north-up map, the right side is east.
比例尺
地圖比例為 1:10,000，圖上 3 cm 代表實際多遠？
At a scale of 1:10,000, what distance does 3 cm represent?
降雨資料
三天雨量依次為 5、0、16 mm，總雨量是多少？
Rainfall on three days is 5, 0 and 16 mm. What is the total?
21 mm|7 mm|16 mm
21 mm|7 mm|16 mm
總量是相加；7 mm 是平均值，不是總量。
Add to obtain the total; 7 mm is the mean, not the total.
城市氣溫
同一天同時量度，樹蔭下 29°C、裸露柏油路 34°C。哪個結論有數據支持？
At the same time on one day, shade measures 29°C and exposed asphalt 34°C. Which conclusion is supported?
此時此地柏油路較高 5°C|所有城市永遠高 5°C|樹蔭必定降雨
The asphalt is 5°C warmer here at this time|Every city is always 5°C warmer|Shade always causes rain
這次觀測只支持指定地點和時間的差異。
This observation supports the difference only at the stated places and time.
抽樣偏差
只在商場訪問遊客，卻推論所有區內居民的交通需要，主要限制是甚麼？
A survey interviews only mall tourists but claims to represent all residents’ transport needs. What is the key limitation?
樣本未涵蓋目標居民|訪問人數越多就必定無偏差|題目用了數字
The sample does not cover the target residents|A larger sample automatically removes bias|Numbers were used
抽樣對象與推論人口不一致。
The sampled group does not match the target population.
空間資料解讀
兩區事故共 40 和 20 宗，人口分別 20,000 和 5,000。比較每千人事故率，哪區較高？
Areas A and B have 40 and 20 incidents with populations 20,000 and 5,000. Which has the higher rate per 1,000 people?
B：每千人 4 宗|A：每千人 40 宗|兩區相同
B: 4 per 1,000|A: 40 per 1,000|They are equal
A 是 2/1,000，B 是 4/1,000；應比較比率而非只看總數。
A is 2/1,000 and B 4/1,000; compare rates rather than raw totals.
computer: 資料與指令
哪一項是輸入資料，而非處理指令？
Which is input data rather than a processing instruction?
學生輸入的溫度 25°C|把溫度加 2|按大小排序
A student’s entered temperature of 25°C|Add 2 to the temperature|Sort values
25°C 是待處理的值；加法和排序是操作。
25°C is a value; addition and sorting are operations.
演算法次序
要計算三個分數的平均，哪個步驟正確？
Which procedure calculates the mean of three scores?
先相加，再除以 3|先加 3，再除以總分|只選最高分
Add the scores, then divide by 3|Add 3, then divide by their sum|Choose only the highest score
平均值是總和除以資料個數。
The mean is the sum divided by the number of values.
布林條件
若登入要求『密碼正確 AND 帳戶啟用』，只有密碼正確時能登入嗎？
Login requires correct password AND active account. Is a correct password alone sufficient?
不能，兩條件都要成立|能，任一條件成立即可|能，AND 代表忽略帳戶
No, both must be true|Yes, either condition is enough|Yes, AND ignores account status
AND 要求所有條件同時成立。
AND requires both conditions to be true.
測試資料
評估分類器時，為何應使用未參與訓練的資料？
Why evaluate a classifier on data not used for training?
檢查對新資料的表現|讓訓練分數必然更高|避免任何錯誤出現
To check performance on unseen data|To guarantee a higher training score|To eliminate every possible error
測試未見資料可減少只記住訓練例子的假象。
Unseen test data helps detect performance based only on memorising training examples.
準確率限制
100 個樣本中 95 個屬 A，模型全部猜 A。95% 準確率能證明它識別 B 很好嗎？
95 of 100 examples are A. A model always predicts A. Does 95% accuracy prove good B recognition?
不能，它沒有識別任何 B|能，95% 已足夠|不能，因為準確率一定是 0%
No, it identifies no B examples|Yes, 95% is sufficient|No, its accuracy must be 0%
整體準確率可能掩蓋少數類別的失敗。
Overall accuracy can hide failure on a minority class.
資料洩漏
預測考試前的學習需要，訓練資料卻包含考試後的總成績，主要問題是甚麼？
A model predicts support needs before an exam but is trained with the final exam score as an input. What is wrong?
使用預測時尚未存在的資料|資料列數一定不足|成績不能用數字表示
It uses information unavailable at prediction time|There must be too few rows|Scores cannot be numeric
這是時間上的資料洩漏，會高估實際可用表現。
This is temporal data leakage and can exaggerate real-world performance.
history: 時間排序
Events occur in 1910, 1890 and 1930. Which is earliest?
在同一公元紀年下，較小年份較早。
Within the same CE chronology, the smaller year comes first.
一手資料
研究一次 1950 年校慶，哪项是一手資料？
Which is a primary source for a school celebration in 1950?
1950 年參與者當日寫的日記|2025 年沒有引文的 AI 摘要|小說中的相似場景
A participant’s diary written that day in 1950|An uncited AI summary written in 2025|A similar fictional scene
同時代親歷記錄是一手資料，但仍須評估其局限。
A contemporary firsthand record is primary evidence, but still has limitations.
來源立場
一份公司宣傳單只強調自己的成就，使用時應怎樣處理？
A company leaflet highlights only its achievements. How should it be used?
考慮目的並與其他來源比較|視為完全中立|一律刪去不用
Consider its purpose and compare other sources|Treat it as fully neutral|Always discard it
有立場的來源仍有價值，但需要交叉核對。
A partial source can still be useful when cross-checked.
連續與轉變
校規 1980 年及 2020 年均要求準時，後者新增網絡私隱條文。哪個描述準確？
Rules in 1980 and 2020 both require punctuality; 2020 adds online privacy. Which description fits?
準時要求延續，私隱內容新增|所有規則都改變|完全沒有改變
Punctuality continues; privacy provisions are new|Every rule changed|Nothing changed
比較具體條文，可同時識別延續及轉變。
Comparing specific provisions reveals both continuity and change.
多重成因
兩份來源分別指出交通改善及學費資助提高入學率。較合理的分析是甚麼？
Two sources link enrolment growth to better transport and fee support. What analysis is reasonable?
考慮兩者及其他因素的共同作用|只保留最早找到的原因|把相關當作唯一因果證明
Consider their combined role and other factors|Keep only the first cause found|Treat correlation as proof of a sole cause
歷史變化可能有多個相互影響的成因。
Historical change may have several interacting causes.
史料互證
三篇網站文章逐字轉載同一份回憶錄，是否等於三份獨立證據？
Three websites reproduce the same memoir word for word. Are these three independent sources?
不是，來源仍同出一份回憶錄|是，網址不同即可|是，篇幅相同更可靠
No, they derive from one memoir|Yes, different URLs suffice|Yes, equal length makes them more reliable
互證需考慮來源獨立性，而非只數網址。
Corroboration depends on source independence, not the number of URLs.
art: 視覺對比
淡黃色字放在白底上難以閱讀，最直接的改善是甚麼？
Pale yellow text is hard to read on white. What is the most direct improvement?
加深文字顏色以提高對比|把文字再變淡|刪除所有文字
Darken the text to increase contrast|Make the text paler|Remove all text
文字和背景需要足夠明暗差異。
Text needs a sufficient light–dark contrast with its background.
構圖層次
海報中標題、日期和裝飾同樣大，最合適的修改是甚麼？
A poster’s title, date and decorations are equally large. What is a useful revision?
建立主次大小及留白|把所有項目都放大|加入更多裝飾遮蓋文字
Create a size hierarchy and spacing|Enlarge everything|Cover text with more decoration
視覺層次協助讀者先看到重點。
Hierarchy helps readers identify important information first.
視覺傳意
要讓不能分辨紅綠的人看懂圖表，應怎樣設計？
How can a chart work for people who cannot distinguish red and green?
加上文字標籤或形狀差異|只換另一對近似顏色|刪除圖例
Add labels or distinct shapes|Use another similar colour pair only|Remove the legend
不要只靠顏色傳遞關鍵資訊。
Do not encode essential information through colour alone.
作品脈絡
AI 只憑畫面顏色便斷言作品主題。哪項資料能幫助檢查？
AI infers an artwork’s theme from colours alone. What can help check the interpretation?
創作脈絡、作者說明及畫面細節|只看 AI 回答長度|只看點讚數
Context, artist statement and visual details|Only the length of the AI answer|Only the number of likes
詮釋需連結視覺證據與脈絡。
Interpretation should connect visual evidence with context.
設計迭代
兩款指示牌試用後，B 的錯走人數較少。下一步較合理是甚麼？
In a sign trial, design B leads to fewer wrong turns. What is a reasonable next step?
檢查樣本與條件，再改進及重測|直接宣稱適用所有地方|只採用設計師喜歡的一款
Review sample and conditions, refine and retest|Claim it works everywhere|Choose only the designer’s favourite
使用者測試是改進線索，仍需檢查情境與限制。
User testing informs revision but must be interpreted in context.
創作決策
展示 AI 輔助作品時，怎樣說明創作過程較清楚？
How should an AI-assisted artwork’s process be explained?
說明自己的決策、工具作用及修改過程|把所有工具結果當成自己手繪|只列出工具名稱不說用途
Describe personal decisions, tool use and revisions|Present every tool output as hand-drawn|Name the tool without explaining its role
清楚的過程說明讓觀眾理解作者的選擇及工具貢獻。
A clear process account distinguishes the artist’s decisions and the tool’s contribution.
music: 節拍
在 4/4 拍中，一小節有多少個四分音符拍？
How many quarter-note beats are in one bar of 4/4?
上方 4 表示每小節四拍，下方 4 表示以四分音符為一拍。
The top 4 gives four beats; the bottom 4 makes the quarter note the beat unit.
音符時值
一個二分音符相當於多少個四分音符？
How many quarter notes equal one half note?
二分音符的時值是四分音符的兩倍。
A half note lasts twice as long as a quarter note.
速度
若每分鐘 60 拍，每拍平均多久？
At 60 beats per minute, how long is one beat?
1 second|60 seconds|0.1 second
60 秒除以 60 拍，等於每拍 1 秒。
60 seconds divided by 60 beats gives one second per beat.
動態記號
樂譜由 p 漸變至 f，主要改變甚麼？
A score moves from p to f. What mainly changes?
由弱至強的音量|必然由慢至快|音高必然上升
Loudness from soft to loud|Tempo must become faster|Pitch must rise
p 和 f 是力度記號，不直接指定速度或音高。
p and f indicate dynamics, not directly tempo or pitch.
比較演奏
要公平比較兩次節奏練習的準確度，應怎樣安排？
How can rhythm accuracy in two practice attempts be compared fairly?
使用相同曲段及速度|同時換曲段和速度|只比較錄音檔大小
Use the same passage and tempo|Change both passage and tempo|Compare file sizes only
控制曲段與速度，才較能比較節奏表現。
Controlling passage and tempo makes the comparison more meaningful.
音樂評論
AI 說『這段演奏情感豐富』。哪種補充最有助分析？
AI calls a performance ‘expressive’. What would make the analysis more useful?
指出具體樂句、力度與節奏處理|重複同一句讚美|只看演奏者外表
Identify particular phrasing, dynamics and timing|Repeat the same praise|Judge the performer’s appearance
音樂評論應以可聽到的具體特徵支持。
A musical judgement should be supported by specific audible features.
library: 查找來源
AI 提供一個書名，你想確定圖書館是否有這本書，應先做甚麼？
AI suggests a book. How can you check whether the library holds it?
查閱圖書館目錄|只相信 AI 說有|只看書名是否好聽
Search the library catalogue|Trust the AI statement alone|Judge how attractive the title sounds
目錄可核對書名、作者及館藏資料。
The catalogue helps verify title, author and holdings.
搜尋關鍵字
要找『香港中學生使用 AI 學習』研究，哪組關鍵字最聚焦？
Which keywords best target research on Hong Kong secondary students learning with AI?
香港 中學生 AI 學習|科技|有趣東西
Hong Kong secondary students AI learning|Technology|Interesting things
具體人口、地點及主題有助縮小搜尋。
Specific population, place and topic narrow the search.
引用追查
AI 摘要附了一個來源連結。下一步應怎樣做？
An AI summary includes a source link. What should you do next?
打開來源核對是否支持摘要|有連結便一定可靠|只數引用數量
Open it and check whether it supports the summary|Assume any link makes it reliable|Count citations only
引用必須存在，而且實際支持所述主張。
A source must exist and actually support the claim.
研究方法
想了解學生對新工具的使用經驗，哪個提問較中立？
Which survey question is more neutral about a new tool?
你使用時遇到哪些幫助或困難？|你是否同意這工具非常完美？|為甚麼你不喜歡這個壞工具？
What helped or challenged you when using it?|Do you agree this tool is perfect?|Why do you dislike this bad tool?
中立提問不預設正面或負面答案。
A neutral question does not presuppose praise or criticism.
研究限制
研究只訪問自願參加的十人，報告應怎樣交代？
A study interviews ten volunteers. What should its report state?
樣本小且自選，推論範圍有限|代表所有學生|不需要交代抽樣方式
The sample is small and self-selected, limiting generalisation|It represents all students|Sampling need not be described
樣本來源與規模影響可作出的推論。
Sample source and size affect what can be inferred.
證據綜合
兩項研究結論不同，合理的處理是甚麼？
Two studies reach different conclusions. What is a reasonable response?
比較對象、方法、情境及不確定性|只留下支持自己立場的一篇|把兩者結論直接相加
Compare participants, methods, contexts and uncertainty|Keep only the one supporting your view|Simply add the conclusions
研究差異可能來自方法和情境，需有根據地綜合。
Different methods and contexts may explain differences; synthesis requires evidence.
rooftop: 觀察紀錄
植物今天高 12 cm，昨天高 10 cm，增加多少？
A plant is 12 cm tall today and 10 cm yesterday. How much has it grown?
2 cm|22 cm|12 cm
2 cm|22 cm|12 cm
用今天高度減去昨天高度：12 − 10 = 2 cm。
Subtract yesterday’s height from today’s: 12 − 10 = 2 cm.
節水計算
原本每天用水 20 L，改善後 15 L，每天節省多少？
Daily water use falls from 20 L to 15 L. How much is saved?
節省量為原用量減新用量。
The saving is original use minus new use.
平均數
三盆植物高度是 8、10、12 cm，平均是多少？
Three plants measure 8, 10 and 12 cm. What is the mean?
10 cm|30 cm|12 cm
10 cm|30 cm|12 cm
公平比較
要比較兩種灌溉方法，哪項安排最合理？
Which design fairly compares two watering methods?
同種植物、相近光照，只改灌溉方法|同時改變植物種類及光照|只量較好的一盆
Use the same plant type and similar light, varying only watering method|Change plant type and light too|Measure only the better plant
控制其他因素，減少混雜解釋。
Control other factors to reduce confounding explanations.
缺失資料
感測器一天沒有記錄溫度，應如何處理該資料？
A sensor records no temperature for one day. How should that entry be treated?
標示缺失並說明處理方法|直接當作 0°C|捏造一個數字不交代
Mark it missing and document handling|Treat it as 0°C|Invent a value without disclosure
沒有量度不等於零；處理缺失資料要透明。
No measurement is not zero; missing-data handling should be transparent.
環境決策
AI 建議增加灌溉，只有一週資料且未計降雨。下一步最好是甚麼？
AI recommends more irrigation using one week of data without rainfall. What is the best next step?
補充降雨及土壤資料，再小規模驗證|立即永久增加用水|只因 AI 建議便停止量度
Add rainfall and soil data, then test on a small scale|Permanently increase water immediately|Stop measuring because AI has advised
先補足重要因素並驗證，可降低錯誤決策。
Add missing relevant factors and validate before committing.
playground: 輪流參與
四人共用一個練習站，哪種安排讓每人都有機會？
Four learners share one practice station. Which arrangement gives everyone a turn?
輪流練習並安排相同時段|只讓最熟練的人做|誰搶到就一直用
Take turns with equal time slots|Only the most skilled learner participates|Whoever gets there keeps it
清楚輪次及時間可保障參與機會。
Clear turns and time slots support participation.
運動紀錄
跑四圈共 8 分鐘，平均每圈是多少？
Four laps take 8 minutes. What is the average per lap?
2 分鐘|4 分鐘|32 分鐘
2 minutes|4 minutes|32 minutes
總時間除以圈數：8 ÷ 4 = 2。
Divide total time by laps: 8 ÷ 4 = 2.
比率比較
甲投中 6/10 球，乙投中 8/20 球，誰命中率較高？
A scores 6/10 shots and B 8/20. Who has the higher success rate?
A: 60%|B: 80%|They are equal
甲 60%，乙 40%；命中數較多不一定比率較高。
A has 60%, B 40%; a larger count does not imply a higher rate.
適應活動
一名同學需要較慢節奏參與小組活動，較共融的安排是甚麼？
A learner needs a slower pace in a group activity. What is more inclusive?
與同學商量並提供合適節奏與角色|直接排除他|完全忽略其需要
Discuss suitable pace and roles with the learner|Exclude the learner|Ignore the need
共融安排讓當事人參與決定並保留學習機會。
Inclusion involves the learner in decisions and preserves learning opportunities.
評估誤差
同一動作的 AI 評分忽高忽低，應先怎樣處理？
AI scores for the same movement vary widely. What should be done first?
檢查拍攝條件及評分可靠性|立刻把最低分當能力|只保留最高分
Check recording conditions and scoring reliability|Treat the lowest as true ability|Keep only the highest
未先了解量度可靠性，不宜作能力判斷。
Assess measurement reliability before judging ability.
公平評量
AI 評分在不同身形學生的誤差不同，下一步應是甚麼？
An AI scoring tool has different errors across body types. What should happen next?
分組檢查誤差並加入人工覆核|只報告總平均|提高速度來掩蓋誤差
Examine group errors and add human review|Report only the overall mean|Increase speed to hide the error
整體平均可能掩蓋特定群體的問題。
An overall mean can conceal problems affecting particular groups.
hall: 私隱選擇
AI 工具索取全班的家庭住址，但活動只需練習句子，應怎樣做？
An AI tool asks for home addresses although the task only practises sentences. What should you do?
不提供無關住址，尋求替代方法|先交出全部資料|請同學把住址貼上公開欄
Withhold irrelevant addresses and seek an alternative|Submit everything first|Post addresses publicly
只收集完成任務所需要的資料。
Collect only information needed for the task.
事實核對
AI 說校慶在星期二，但學校通告寫星期五，應優先如何核實？
AI says an event is Tuesday but the school notice says Friday. How should you check?
查閱最新正式通告並向負責人確認|看 AI 字數較多便相信|隨便選一天
Check the latest official notice and organiser|Trust the longer AI response|Choose randomly
應核對具日期及負責來源的最新資料。
Verify current dated information from the responsible source.
共融溝通
校園指示只有英文，部分新生未能理解，哪項改善較合適？
School instructions are English-only and some new students cannot understand. What helps?
提供所需語言及易懂圖示並試用|指責學生|把字縮小放更多英文
Provide needed languages and clear symbols, then test|Blame the students|Add more English in smaller text
先了解使用者需要，再驗證能否理解。
Understand users’ needs and test comprehension.
申訴機制
AI 自動拒絕學生參加活動，沒有解釋，哪項改善最重要？
AI rejects an activity application without explanation. What is an important improvement?
提供理由與人工覆核途徑|只顯示更漂亮的錯誤頁|禁止提問
Provide reasons and a human review route|Make the error page prettier|Forbid questions
受影響的人需要理解決定並有機會提出異議。
Affected people need to understand and challenge a decision.
群體影響
整體滿意度 90%，但需要字幕的學生只有 40% 滿意。應如何解讀？
Overall satisfaction is 90%, but only 40% among students needing captions. What does this suggest?
需改善該群體的使用障礙|90% 表示所有人都適用|少數群體不需要考慮
Access barriers for that group need attention|90% means it works for everyone|Minority groups need not be considered
總平均不足以代表每個群體的經驗。
An overall average does not represent every group’s experience.
持續治理
學校試行 AI 一個月後，哪個後續方案較完整？
After a one-month AI pilot, which follow-up plan is strongest?
持續收集分組回饋、監察錯誤並定期覆核|成功一次便永不再檢查|只保留宣傳中的正面數字
Collect group feedback, monitor errors and review regularly|Never check again after one success|Keep only positive publicity figures
負責任使用需要持續監察與受影響者參與。
Responsible use requires ongoing monitoring and participation.
